options.name: 显示本月用量
options.note: 在「今日用量」中显示 Cursor 本月已用的额度和重置日期，用量统计中计入 Cursor 的 token 和花费
options.noteEn: Show how much of this month's Cursor usage you've used, and when it resets, under Today's usage, and count Cursor's tokens and spend in usage stats
options.optIn: Cursor 不在本机记录用量，也没有提供第三方查询接口。打开后，Kiteline 将读取 Cursor 保存在本机的登录凭证（编辑器数据目录中 state.vscdb 的 cursorAuth/accessToken 一项，只装了命令行时读其 auth.json），每 10 分钟向 Cursor 服务器查询一次本月用量、套餐和每次请求的 token 用量，与 Cursor 设置页显示的一致。凭证仅在本机使用，不会上传，也不会发送到手机。此查询方式并非 Cursor 官方提供，Cursor 更新后可能失效。
options.optInEn: Cursor doesn't record usage on your computer and offers no third-party usage API. When turned on, Kiteline reads the sign-in token Cursor stores on this computer (cursorAuth/accessToken in the editor's state.vscdb, or the CLI's auth.json if only the CLI is installed) and asks Cursor's servers for this month's usage, plan and per-request token usage every 10 minutes, the same figures shown in Cursor's settings. The token is used only on this computer; it is never uploaded or sent to your phone. This isn't an official Cursor interface and may stop working after a Cursor update.

limitsNote: 打开下方「显示本月用量」后，在「今日用量」中显示 Cursor 本月用量（按账单月）
limitsNoteEn: Turn on “Show monthly usage” below to see Cursor's usage for the current billing month under Today's usage
speaker: Cursor
notes: 打开「显示本月用量」后，用量统计（「今日用量」和用量页的 token、花费，按模型、项目、Agent 分）也计入 Cursor。
notesEn: With Show monthly usage turned on, usage stats (tokens and spend in Today’s Usage and on the Usage page, by model, project and agent) now include Cursor.
